**The EIPsInsight team would like to demo :**

* The new **Included EIP Authors** section to visualize author contributions across Ethereum network upgrades.

I’d like to present a new local build system for the EIP WG repos that makes local full-pipeline builds much easier, lowers the cost of contributing to the repo/tooling stack, and removes a lot of the current multi-repo setup friction.

I have a working system ready and expect to have the PRs public for review by the time of the meeting. While I wish I could demo everything live, the site build process still takes 10+ minutes even after the move from Jekyll to Zola, so not great for meetings!

-Rito

Add to agenda: this PR https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11353. EDIT: realized it was already part of agenda.

The author wants to link from two EIPs https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7979, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8013 to this document. We should discuss this, where do we place documents which are shared or linked to by multiple EIPs, or do we want this as informational EIP?

> The author wants to link from two EIPs https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7979, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8013 to this document. We should discuss this, where do we place documents which are shared or linked to by multiple EIPs, or do we want this as informational EIP?

Perhaps a similar approach could be considered for EIP-7979 and/or EIP-8013 to include relevant supporting information.
